data.eyebrow: In Aid of the Riverside Conservancy
data.headline:
The Lumière
Gala
data.dek: An evening of light, in service of the river that gives us ours. Saturday, 21 November · 7 O'Clock · The Old Customs Hall.

data.quote: A single night that keeps a river alive for another generation.
data.body: For fourteen years the Riverside Conservancy has restored the wetlands, returned the otters, and reopened the banks. The Lumière Gala is the night we gather to ensure the next fourteen — over dinner, music, and an auction of once-in-a-lifetime lots, every penny of which flows back to the water.

phases: Received in the lantern-lit courtyard with a glass of vintage cuvée and a string quartet.
A five-course menu by Chef Aurélie Vasseur, composed entirely of produce from the river valley.
A few words on the year behind, and the river still to be won back.
Our auctioneer takes the rostrum for twelve extraordinary lots. Paddles at the ready.
An intimate set beneath the great hall's lanterns — a surprise guest of some renown.
The floor opens and the bar warms. We dance until the lanterns are spent.

data.intro: Twelve lots, each donated in full. Every paddle raised becomes water restored.
